name: empty-submessage-when-implicit-leaves-out-the-only-field
reference: spec/engine-spec.md 0.56 `implicit`; protobuf encoding of 0.3/0.5 (tag = field<<3 | wire type, varint base 128 low group first, fields in ascending number). Input 4a 02 08 00: field 9 holds 9.1 = 0, kind sub (when 9 present). Encode: y 0 is left out by implicit; "A field that implicit leaves out counts as not written for ruling 14 of 0.5", so nothing under 9 is written and the encoder writes an empty field 9: 4a 00. Derived by hand.
